feature_blueprint.name: app_burst_sessionization
what_to_measure: sessionized app bursts from usage-stat timestamp deltas, not daily total usage
late-evening and post-midnight reactivation bursts coupled with screen-on persistence
subject-relative deviation from recent same-subject burst timing and duration
feature_blueprint.why_not_repeat_phase3_usage_temporal: The failed phase3 usage-temporal lane used aggregate daily category totals. This design promotes only ordered burst/session shape and keeps raw app names out of model features.

feature_blueprint.name: semantic_app_category_markov_chain
what_to_measure: category transition entropy and self-transition streaks within evening windows
rare transition motifs such as communication→finance/shop or media/search→system_home loops
Markov surprise versus each subject's rolling baseline transition matrix
feature_blueprint.leakage_guard: Use only fixed hand-written app categories; no target-guided app vocabulary or raw app one-hot.

feature_blueprint.name: ambience_guarded_context_burst
what_to_measure: speech/music/vehicle ambience flags around high-intensity app bursts
context disagreement: quiet ambience but high app-switching, or noisy ambience plus late reactivation
feature_blueprint.reopen_guard: mAmbience is a guard/context source only because the ambience closure found full-OOF traps and no nested positive signal.

decision.next_action: Do not create ID342. The next no-approval step may only be a metadata/cardinality smoke for session state counts and Markov state coverage; no feature parquet, model, Kaggle run, or DACON submission.
